name: my-plan
description: Eight independent skills — map, spec, plan, review-plan, implement, review, validate, commit — that take a goal to reviewed, committed code one manual step at a time. No orchestration, no run state, no runtime in your repo: plain files under docs/, an independent reviewer, a secret-scanned commit, and never a push.

interface.shortDescription: Eight sharp skills from goal to committed code
interface.longDescription: Eight independent skills covering the whole arc of a change: map writes a repository navigator, spec turns a goal into a decision-complete brief, plan turns the brief into a task board, review-plan attacks the plan before code exists, implement builds one task at a time, review checks the diff against eleven lenses, validate re-runs the real commands and reports real exit codes, and commit stages exactly what was intended — scanned for secrets, never pushed. Each is usable alone; ordinary files under docs/ are the only state between them.
defaultPrompt: Use My Plan to write docs/map.md — the navigator every other My Plan skill reads first — with $my-plan:map.
Use My Plan to turn a goal into a decision-complete brief with $my-plan:spec.
Use My Plan to turn a brief into a task board with $my-plan:plan.
Use My Plan to review this diff against the eleven-lens checklist with $my-plan:review.
